newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Hindalco up 3.6 pct on BSE.
newsitem.headline: India's Hindalco up 3.6 pct on BSE.

text.p: Shares of India's largest private aluminium maker Hindalco jumped 33 rupees, or 3.6 percent, to 958.50 on Monday in afternoon trade on the Bombay bourse, traders said.
They said Hindalco would benefit from an increase in the import duty of aluminium announced in the country's federal budget last month.
Finance Minister P. Chidambaram increased the import duty to 20 percent from the existing 10 percent.
Tax cuts announced in the budget are also expected to benefit the firm, analysts said.
Hindalco shares have rallied nearly 30 percent after the budget.
State-run aluminium firm NALCO -- also seen as a winner after the budget -- rose 3.0 rupees to 47.50 on the Bombay bourse.
